title: Your Inbox Became Your To-Do List. That's Why You Never Feel Caught Up.
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: You opened your inbox to check quickly. Two hours just disappeared.
Your inbox shows messages by arrival time, not by what matters.
A client emergency sits next to a newsletter. Both look equally urgent.
Inbox zero just empties the queue so it can fill up again.
Sort the noise automatically. Move real tasks to a real list.
The full breakdown is on the blog — link is in the comments.
